headline: US executive order forces federal contractors to clear congressional disclosures
summary: US President Donald Trump issued an executive order requiring companies holding federal contracts to notify the White House before sharing information with Congress and withhold confidential material.
why: Federal contractors handle billions in government defense and IT procurements. Executive oversight mandates alter legal compliance protocols for defense vendors.

impacts.name: US Defense Contractors
impacts.why: Federal contractors face stricter administrative disclosure restrictions before providing material to Congress.
